text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Mark Toffoli has resigned from the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee effective April 10, 2025. We would like to thank Mark for their contributions to the Committee. City staff will lead a process to bring nominated candidates to City Council for their consideration to fill this vacancy and the vacancy resulting from the resignation of Apt’sqi’gnn ᐊᑉᑦ ᔅᑭ ᒃᓐᓐ on February 4, 2025.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
